headline.title: Two blocks up Locke Street, Function101 has 224 five-star reviews and opens at 7am.
headline.detail: In our search for physiotherapy on Locke Street, Medimap pages about you and Regent Health Centre filled the results; your own website didn't appear. Three clinics compete for the same street.

summary: Thrive Physiotherapy has 133 reviews at 4.9 and patients who say Nupur and Nikita bring relief from the very first visit. But Locke Street has three strong clinics within a few hundred metres, Function101 has 224 five-star reviews, and in our search your own website did not appear.

search.result: Medimap pages for Regent Health Centre and Thrive Physiotherapy filled the results, with Fresha directory pages below. Your own website (thrivephysio.com) did not appear.
search.meaning: People find you through a directory that lists you next to your neighbours, not through your own page.

visibility: In our search for physiotherapy on Locke Street you appeared only through Medimap. A clinic two blocks away has more reviews and opens earlier.
